elements: Global VIN/Brand/Model Search Input with magnifying glass icon and subtle hotkey pill ('Strg + K')
Live Auctions indicator badge with pulsating red dot
Favorites icon button with counter badge
Notifications bell button with unread red badge count
User profile chip displaying company name (e.g. 'Autohaus Schmidt GmbH'), user role ('Händler' or 'Autohaus'), and avatar initial badge

sections: Welcome Hero Banner: Dark textured backdrop with dark luxury car visual, title 'Fahrzeuge schnell & profitabel vermarkten', subtitle, and red primary CTA 'Neues Fahrzeug einstellen'
KPI Metrics Row: 4 stat cards (Aktive Auktionen, Veraufte Fahrzeuge, Durchschnittspreis, Gebote gesamt) with +/- % delta badges and icon badges
Horizontal Stepper Pipeline: Active inspection & selling status (Annahme -> Aufbereitung -> In Auktion -> Verkauft -> Abholung)
My Vehicles Data Table: Tab filters (Alle, Entwürfe, In Auktion, Verkauft, Nicht Verkauft), search bar, column sorting, vehicle thumbnail, VIN, price, bid count, status pill, action menu
Active Auctions Quick Cards: Horizontal scrolling or grid of ending auctions with live countdown badges and quick-bid triggers
Right-Hand Analytics Rail: Monthly Sales Bar Chart (recharts), Sell-Through Rate Donut Chart, Recent Messages List, Important Documents Download Box
Hero Banner & Live Metrics: Total live vehicles counter, reserve met count, total value
Multi-Filter Search Bar: Dropdowns for Marke/Modell, Baujahr, Kilometerstand bis, Kraftstoff, Getriebe, Standorte + prominent Red 'Auktionen Filtern' button
Category Pill Chips: Horizontal filter bar (Alle (128), PKW (84), Transporter (18), SUV (22), Elektro/Hybrid (12), Sofortkauf (8))
Grid Control Bar: Grid/List layout toggle, Sort dropdown (Endet bald, Neuester Eingang, Gebote), Results count

Vehicle Card Grid (3 columns on desktop): Responsive card with vehicle photo, status pill (LIVE/Endet bald), countdown badge with flame icon, favorite heart toggle, Title (e.g. '2021 BMW 320d Touring xDrive M Sport'), Meta icons (2021 • 74.500 km • Diesel • 190 PS), Current Bid / Next Bid, Red button 'Jetzt bieten'
Right Rail Sidebar: 'Meine aktiven Gebote' widget, 'Endet in unter 1 Stunde' list, 'Neu eingetroffen' list
Top Navigation Breadcrumb: '< Zurück zur Übersicht' + Next/Previous Vehicle fast switch buttons + Vehicle ID #AK-8842
Vehicle Image Gallery: Main featured viewer with zoom overlay, thumbnail carousel (Exterior, Interior, Engine, Tire Tread, Damage close-ups), PDF B2B Gutachten badge
Key Spec Highlights Grid: 8 icon chips (Leistung, Kraftstoff, Getriebe, Erstzulassung, Kilometer, HU/AU, Fahrzeughalter, Schadstoffklasse)
Tabbed Detail Panels: 'Übersicht', 'Ausstattung', 'Zustand & Schäden', 'Lackschichtmessung', 'Reifen & Bremsen', 'Diagnose & Fehler', 'Dokumente & B2B-Gutachten', 'Standort & Abholung'

Prominent Live Auction Panel (Fixed Right Side): Large Live Countdown HH:MM:SS box, Aktuelles Höchstgebot (€ 24.500), Mindestpreis status indicator bar ('Mindestpreis erreicht'), Big Red Button 'Jetzt € 24.600 bieten', Quick increment buttons (+€100, +€250, +€500), Custom Max-Bid Input ('Maximalgebot setzen'), Live Bidding History stream table with real-time websocket pulse effect, Seller info box (Anonymized until auction won)

buttons.primary: bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-semibold py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-semibold py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-200
buttons.outline_red: border-2 border-red-600 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xs hover:shadow-sm transition-shadow p-5

data_tables.wrapper: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xs
data_tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider px-4 py-3 text-left
data_tables.row: border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition-colors text-sm text-slate-700

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all buttons, form inputs, links, status badges, data table rows, and bidding controls include explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='place-bid-button', data-testid='search-input', data-testid='vehicle-card-1').
Keep the left dark sidebar visible across all authenticated routes with '#0B0F17' background and red '#DC2626' active highlights.
Use German language terminology across the entire UI ('Jetzt bieten', 'Sofortkauf', 'Endet bald', 'Mindestpreis erreicht', 'Händler', 'Autohaus').
Maintain high density, clean data presentation, crisp borders, and zero transparent overlays on popups/dropdowns.
